build_bot_adversarial_dialogue_dataset: build a TensorFlow dataset builder for bot_adversarial_dialogue with dialogue_datasets config
create_dataset_builder_info: create dataset metadata using _info method with features, homepage, and license from Builder class
generate_dataset_splits: generate train, valid, and test splits from downloaded bot_adversarial_dialogue tarball
parse_dialogue_examples: parse tab-delimited dialogue rows into structured examples with id, text, labels, and episode_done fields
preprocess_dialogue_rows: preprocess bot_adversarial_dialogue rows by unescaping tabs, newlines, and replacing PIPE markers
